## The problem

Great HVAC Work Is Not Enough If Homeowners Cannot Find and Trust You.

You know the pattern: July is packed, then shoulder season leaves open slots. Larger competitors can outspend you. Shared-lead programs can send the same homeowner inquiry to several companies. And a marketing report is not enough if it cannot show whether your investment is creating qualified service and replacement opportunities.

When homeowners need AC repair, furnace replacement, or maintenance, they often search nearby companies, read reviews, and decide who to call. If your company is hard to find or does not look trustworthy in local search, you can lose the opportunity before your team has a chance to earn the job. Create helps you show up more credibly in the service areas you want to serve.

The goal is to make your company easier to find directly when homeowners search, so shared lead sellers are not your only path to new work.

## The data

The Numbers Behind Every HVAC Job You Win or Lose

Published industry research and platform data show how homeowners and local consumers choose service businesses. These figures are industry research, not SalesAI client results.

1. Marketing LTB's 2026 HVAC marketing-statistics article states that 78 percent of homeowners search online before contacting an HVAC company and 52 percent choose the first company they contact. The article does not provide a study citation, methodology, or sample details. Source: https://marketingltb.com/blog/statistics/hvac-marketing-statistics/
2. A 2024 survey conducted by Clear Seas Research with The ACHR News found that 91 percent of 400 homeowner respondents rated online reviews as important when choosing an HVAC contractor. Source: https://www.achrnews.com/articles/155206-91-of-homeowners-rely-on-online-reviews-before-picking-contractors
3. BrightLocal's 2026 survey of 1,002 U.S. adults found that 47 percent would not use a business with fewer than 20 reviews, while 31 percent would only use one rated 4.5 stars or higher. This is general local-business research, not HVAC-specific. Source: https://www.brightlocal.com/research/local-consumer-review-survey/
4. BrightLocal's 2024 survey of 1,141 U.S. consumers found that 88 percent would use a business that responds to positive and negative reviews, compared with 47 percent who would consider using one that never responds. This is general local-business research, not HVAC-specific. Source: https://www.brightlocal.com/research/local-consumer-review-survey-2024/
5. Google-hosted Business Profile guidance states that customers are 2.7 times more likely to consider a business reputable when they find a complete Business Profile on Google Search and Maps. It also states that customers are 70 percent more likely to visit. The guidance is from a Google Product Expert and does not publish study methodology. Source: https://support.google.com/business/thread/298203073/profile-says-incomplete?hl=en
6. A 2011 Google and Ipsos study found that 88 percent of smartphone users who looked up local information took some action within a day. The study reports calls and visits separately. Source: https://www.gstatic.com/ads/research/en/2011_TheMobileMovement.pdf

Create is built to move every one of these numbers in your favor: visibility, review volume, review responses, and a complete, active Google Business Profile.

## What Create does

Build a Stronger Local Presence for Your HVAC Business

Create helps make your HVAC company easier to find and trust in the service areas you want to serve. We handle the ongoing marketing work so you can focus on crews, customers, and the schedule.

- Be easier to find when local homeowners need HVAC help
- Build reviews that give homeowners more reason to choose you
- Reach homeowners looking for the service and replacement work you provide
- Know what is being done, why it matters, and what comes next
- Build a local presence that is not dependent on shared leads
- Get marketing support without having to manage it yourself

Focus your local presence on the service, maintenance, and replacement opportunities you want in the areas you can serve profitably.

## A four-stage plan

Four Stages. One Purpose. Help More Local Homeowners Find and Choose Your HVAC Company.

### Stage 1: Get Found Locally

Put the essentials in place so homeowners in your service area can find clear business information, see a credible local presence, and contact your company.

Included:

- Google Business Profile improvements that make key company information easier for homeowners to find and use
- Ongoing local visibility work handled for you each month
- Accurate company information across local search and directory sites
- A review-request process for completed jobs
- A monthly owner update showing completed work and local visibility activity
- A service-area competitor review to identify gaps in how your company is presented online

### Stage 2: Build Trust Before the Call

Build the review and local-search foundation that can help your company present more credibly when homeowners compare AC repair, furnace replacement, and maintenance providers.

Included:

- All Stage 1 work
- A review-request and response process designed to support local trust
- Automatic review requests after completed jobs, so asking does not depend on your team remembering
- Review responses that show homeowners an active, accountable company
- Local-search work focused on the HVAC services and communities where you want more qualified opportunities

### Stage 3: Build Trust and Track Inquiries

Make it easier for homeowners to find useful service information while giving you clearer visibility into the marketing sources behind phone inquiries.

Included:

- All Stage 1 and Stage 2 work
- Call-source tracking to show which marketing sources generated phone inquiries
- Service and replacement information that helps homeowners understand what you offer before they call
- Dedicated pages for priority HVAC services and communities, making relevant information easier to find
- Local credibility work that supports how your company is discovered online

### Stage 4: Expand What Works

Once the core work is in place, add paid media and automation around the services, areas, and priorities that matter most to your company.

Included:

- All Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 work
- Paid advertising focused on the services and communities that fit your growth priorities
- Automation that reduces routine marketing coordination for your team
- A market plan matched to your service mix, service area, and capacity

Book a 15-Minute Demo to review your service area, priorities, and the stage that fits your business.

## The first 90 days

What Happens in Your First 90 Days

### Days 1 to 30: Make It Easier to Be Found and Trusted Locally

We improve the business information homeowners see when they search for HVAC help, so they can quickly understand your services, service area, and how to contact you. We make your business details more consistent across relevant local listings, set up a simple way to request reviews after completed jobs, and provide a plainspoken monthly update showing what we completed, what changed, and what we will prioritize next.

### Days 31 to 60: Focus Your Visibility on the HVAC Work You Want More Of

We finish extending consistent business details across relevant local listings, begin sending review requests after completed jobs, and focus local visibility work on the HVAC services and service areas that matter most to your business.

### Days 61 to 90: Make It Easier for Ready-to-Hire Homeowners to Contact You

We review the business details homeowners see, the way reviews are answered, and the information they use to compare HVAC companies, then make it easier for them to contact you. Your 90-day update shows the work completed, the visibility data available, and the next priorities for the service areas you want to grow.

These descriptions state work performed, not promised business outcomes.

## The guarantee

Our 90-Day Visibility Guarantee

More Google Business Profile visibility in 90 days, or we keep working at no additional service fee until you get it.

If your Google Business Profile views do not increase during your first 90 days with Create, we will continue the visibility work included in your plan at no additional service fee until they do. Eligibility requirements, customer responsibilities, and exclusions apply.

The 90-day guarantee period begins on the date we receive usable access to your verified Google Business Profile.

No contracts. No hidden fees.

We measure Google Business Profile views using Google Business Profile performance data. Views show visibility, not calls, booked jobs, sales, or revenue. We compare the final 30 complete days of your first 90 days with the 30 complete days immediately before the guarantee start date. Any increase in Google Business Profile views satisfies the guarantee.

This is a continued-work guarantee, not a money-back guarantee. It applies only to Google Business Profile views and does not promise a specific position or any increase in leads, calls, sales, revenue, or another business result. Advertising spend, third-party charges, add-ons, website work, reputation-management work, and services outside the contracted plan are not included in the no-fee work unless stated otherwise in writing.

Guarantee subject to Terms of Service, eligibility requirements, and customer responsibilities. See full guarantee terms for details.
